name: symbai
description: Read sales, products, orders and stock from your Symbai company.

interface.longDescription: Ask about sales, products, orders and recorded stock in your Symbai company. Compare periods, find best-selling products and inspect product and order details using the access granted to your employee account. Requires an existing Symbai account and AI access enabled by your company administrator. This version reads data; it does not change products, stock, orders or payments.
defaultPrompt: Which products sold best this month?
Show the current recorded stock in my warehouses.
